canonical_title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
description: The paper presents TauIndianBankBench, a new evaluation suite that tests conversational agents on their ability to follow bank‑specific procedural rules and perform tool‑based actions, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit, in the context of Indian banks' FAQ and chatbot services.

canonical_title: Spike-Aware Gradient-Based Mixed-Precision Quantization of Spiking Neural Networks for Vision Applications
description: The paper introduces a spike-aware, gradient‑based mixed‑precision quantization technique for spiking neural networks (SNNs) targeting vision tasks. It addresses the previously unexplored challenge of preserving SNN accuracy under low‑precision constraints and proposes an alternative to memory‑intensive Hessian‑based methods such as HAWQ‑V2.

canonical_title: IFC-MCQ: Automatically Generating Multiple-Choice Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Agents on IFC Data Retrieval
description: Researchers introduced IFC‑MCQ, a technique that creates multiple‑choice questions directly from Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) files, providing exact‑option benchmarks for testing large language model agents that retrieve IFC data.

canonical_title: Stream low-latency speech from AI agents using Kokoro TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI
description: AWS released a guide showing how to stream speech from an AI agent sentence‑by‑sentence using the Kokoro‑82M text‑to‑speech model hosted on SageMaker, sending the audio to a browser via Server‑Sent Events or a unified binary transport instead of waiting for the full response.

canonical_title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
description: Canva introduced its first AI image generation model, called Canva Craft. The model uses a two‑stage architecture that first plans a design and then generates the image, which Canva says provides greater precision, consistency and control. It is positioned as a direct competitor to image models from OpenAI, Microsoft and Google.
